title: Trail Blazers' Ja Morant ruled out of loss to Grizzlies with hamstring injury
text: Trail Blazers' Ja Morant ruled out of loss to Grizzlies with hamstring injury Morant's 'revenge game' against his former team ended early due to injury, before Memphis got the win to move to 5-0 on the season. Ja Morant dropped several highlights in the Trail Blazers' loss to the Grizzlies before leaving with a hamstring injury. Ja Morant's first meeting with his former team as a Portland Trail Blazer came to an early end, after the guard exited the game with a left hamstring injury. Halfway through the fourth quarter of Thursday's game against the Memphis Grizzlies, Morant appeared to grab at his left hamstring after a few back-and-forth plays. He went to the bench shortly afterwards and had his leg checked out on the sideline. Prior to leaving with the injury, Morant struggled with shooting but dropped some big highlights in the contest.In one moment late in the second quarter, the guard dropped a floating jumper past Grizzlies guard Cedric Coward; Morant then seemingly mouthed \"he food\" at the crowd while pointing towards Coward. The game was close at first, with the two teams tied up at halftime, but Memphis started to pull away in the second half to get the win.Cameron Boozer, the, earned his first triple-double in the victory, which moves the Grizzlies to 5-0 on the season. Morant's time with Memphis — from when he was drafted by the team in 2019 until his trade this summer — was often defined by his off-field issues. He wasThe trade to Portland felt like a chance for the Grizzlies to turn the page on a disappointing era, while also giving Morant a fresh start.Morant's time with the Trail Blazers had seemed positive so far, with the guard leading the team in assists and serving as a complimentary scorer to teammates Deni Avdija and Damian Lillard.
summary: Ja Morant's first meeting with his former team as a Portland Trail Blazer came to an early end, after the guard exited the game with a left hamstring injury.
